title: LEDGER
description: One aligned table of the work, with a live miniature in every row. Search, enlarge and read in place.
signature: A single clock drives 28 invented miniatures, pausing hidden cells. The focused cell expands while the ledger reflows; each case opens in its row.
holdback: Repeated schematic miniatures limit the novelty; enlarged canvas lettering is soft. The later LEDGER density spec overrides the older large-type/colour-area gate. Physical mid-range-phone performance remains unverified.
antiPale: pass under consult density exception; legacy test fails
